pages.text: $(o)Journal of the Order of Watchers, first entry.$()$(br2)We raised small shrines wherever the sky is open: in forests, on plains and meadows, in the taiga and the savanna. Look for weathered stone brick, moss and the blue flame of soul lanterns.

pages.title: A Fallen Shrine
pages.text: Weathered stone, moss and a single chest in the altar niche.
The shrines lie far apart, several hundred blocks from one another. In the chest of each one, the Order left the next page of this journal.$(br2)Find a Fallen Shrine and recover it.
